title: Prague, measured: five studies of one city from the data it publishes about itself
description: Five studies of Prague from open administrative data: votes against in the City Assembly 2010–2026; housing estates and the 2025 vote by precinct; city grants to the 57 districts and party alignment; new housing, permits, completions and the metro; and longer cars on the paid kerb. Each part fixes its hypotheses, tests and reporting sentences in an analysis plan committed before the analysis (commit times self-reported). The archive holds the articles (HTML and PDF in assets/pdf/), the designs (docs/research/), the code (tools/) and the published data (assets/).
